pattern: ^SELECT .* FROM .* WHERE FlightNo IN \(( SELECT .* FROM .*\) SUBQUERY WHERE .*\) AND FlightNo IN \(( SELECT .* FROM .*\) SUBQUERY WHERE .*\)
correction: Join the AIRLINES and FLIGHTS tables directly using the 'uid' field, filtering the flights based on the source airport in each subquery.

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly join tables using subqueries instead of directly joining them.
